function update<T extends object>(obj: T, key: keyof T, value: T[keyof T]): Partial<T> {
  const changes: Partial<T> = {};
  changes[key] = value;
  return changes;
}
console.log(update({ a: 1 }, "a", 2));
class C<E> { ls: Partial<E> = {}; }
class Emitter<E extends Record<string, any>> { private ls: { [K in keyof E]?: ((e: E[K]) => void)[] } = {}; }
function h<K extends string>() { const x: { [P in K]?: number } = {}; return x; }
